source.title: Nico Rosberg — Formula 1 Hall of Fame
source.author: Gerald Donaldson (verify page byline)
source.locator: See precise paragraph or heading locator on each linked claim; unlinked claims remain pending.
source.verification_note: Formula 1 Hall of Fame text inspected on 2026-10-24; unlinked claims still require direct corroboration; no human EN/UK review or independent publisher corroboration.

claims.en: Rosberg won the 2016 Formula 1 Drivers' World Championship with Mercedes.
claims.uk: Росберг виграв чемпіонат світу Формули-1 серед пілотів 2016 року з Mercedes.

evidence.locator: Hall of Fame heading '2016' and 2016 Mercedes team rivalry paragraphs.

claims.en: Rosberg secured the 2016 title in the final race ahead of Mercedes team-mate Lewis Hamilton.
claims.uk: Росберг здобув титул 2016 року на фінальному етапі, випередивши напарника по Mercedes Льюїса Гамільтона.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Thereafter they traded race wins': 2016 title decided at Abu Dhabi against Hamilton.

claims.en: Rosberg announced his retirement from Formula 1 five days after winning the 2016 championship.
claims.uk: Росберг оголосив про завершення кар’єри у Формулі-1 через п’ять днів після здобуття титулу 2016 року.

evidence.locator: Opening paragraph and paragraph beginning 'He was still smiling': retirement five days after 2016 title.

gaps: Record precise per-claim source locators and independent corroboration.
Human review of both languages and exact revision required before publication.
